title: Clock and Date
drDigitalIntro:
The clock in the top-right corner of the menu bar shows the current time.
• Click on it to see today's full date and the time.
• This is useful when you need to check what day it is without opening a calendar.
• On a real computer, clicking the clock may also show upcoming calendar events.
• Look at your own computer's menu bar right now — you should see the time in the top-right corner.

playgroundTask.goal: Open the clock panel and read today's date

steps.say: Click the time in the top-right corner of the menu bar.
Read today's date, then close the panel.

drDigitalSuccess: You opened the clock panel and found the date — great exploring!
drDigitalHint: Look at the very top-right of the playground. You should see the time. Click it to open the panel.
